notes: Tessellate, split in two: the 1x1 body a Tessellate becomes at `split_on_death` (THE SMALL RIG: kind "small", 25x25, pivot (12,12)). The same 2x2 bots with 1 px gaps as the full swarm, in a 4x4 lattice (about half of the bots: a two-bot head, a four-bot shoulder row, a sash row). Legs, torso and head stay inside the central 15x15 (pivot +-7); only the short bot trails of the arms reach the shared mounts (item top-left = mount - item.grip as everywhere; hand anchors are art only). Same head variants and outfit mask as `tessellate`. The outline is round the outside of the swarm only. Same rig as human: every layer faces UP at rotation 0 on one 25x25 frame, rotate about the pivot; outfit pixels are neutral grey in the base PNG and white in *_color.png (multiply by the outfit colour there); no baked shadow.

legs.notes: frames 0 and 3 are the contacts; the swing boot (frames 1-2 right, 4-5 left) is lifted

arms.notes: item placement: item top-left = mount - item.grip (both unrotated), then rotate the upper group about the pivot. Mounts are identical on every species (and the human), so any item fits any body. Pose = the item's class: pistol, rifle, tool, heavy, melee. RIG KIND small: this frame is 25x25 with the pivot at (12,12), so every mount here is the shared one moved by (-4,-4): mount - pivot is identical to the human rig. The hand anchors are art only (kept inside the frame).
